subject: Follow-up: Budget slabs, token volumes, and residency cost impact
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finovate.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@finovate.io>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Intro + demo follow-up

Thanks Naomi — good call earlier. I pulled together the initial token-volume sketch (attached). A few clarifications before we lock next steps:

- Baseline consumption: ~40M tokens/month for the first 6 months, ramping to ~150M by month 12 (see sheet tab "expected").
- Heavy inference is chat-like (avg 45 tokens in prompt, 120 tokens output) for our agent product; embeddings for search are ~10M vectors/month.
- Residency: default is US, but EU is a hard requirement for a pilot with BankCo EMEA — they'd need data-at-rest in EU and audit logs kept there. That may change economics; can you share a rough delta?
- Budget: Maria asked for a target cost band — we were thinking in the neighborhood of $700–$1,200 per 1M tokens (inclusive of inference + embeddings) for the pilot. Is that realistic?

Attached: volume_estimates_q4.csv.

Cheers,
Alex
Product Lead, Finovate Labs

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finovate.io>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo follow-up

Alex — thanks for the file and the clear numbers. Quick recap and what I want to get aligned on: 

1) Volume profile — we can use your monthly ramp table to produce two unit-econ scenarios (Hosted US and Hosted EU) plus a Dedicated-reserved estimate if you expect steady high throughput.
2) Residency impact — high level: EU-hosted will generally add a ~15–30% per-token premium vs US-hosted due to regional infra and cross-border routing, and audit-retention options can add another fixed monthly fee depending on retention window. I’ll attach a short cheat sheet that outlines the drivers.
3) Target $/1M tokens — $700–$1,200 is a wide band; I want to translate that into committed vs on-demand pricing. For example:
   - On-demand hosted (US): typically $900–$1,400 per 1M tokens for chat-heavy workloads at your volumes.
   - Committed (monthly commit + 12mo): can get to $550–$900 per 1M depending on commit level and model tier.
   - EU-hosted: expect +20% delta on the above ranges as a starting point.

Next steps I propose: please confirm which of the two pilots should be EU-resident (BankCo EMEA or the general pilot), and grant permission to share the SOC2 and residency layout with Maria (need a signed NDA for some artifacts). If you’re comfortable, Jordan (copied) will run a quick committed-capacity sketch against your ramp and show three pricing slabs (on-demand, 3mo commit, 12mo commit).

I’ll attach the residency cheat sheet and a short example slab math.

Best,
Naomi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finovate.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@finovate.io>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo follow-up

Thanks Naomi — Maria wants the BankCo EMEA pilot to be EU-resident. She also confirmed we can sign a mutual NDA to get the SOC2 material. On budgets: Maria is leaning toward the lower end of our band and wants an aggressive committed number if we can show predictable latency and an SLA.

Can Jordan sketch two concrete scenarios next week:
- Scenario A: Hosted EU, 6-month pilot, expected avg 60M tokens/month, target <= $850 / 1M tokens effective
- Scenario B: Committed Dedicated pool (EU), 12-month, ramp to 150M tokens/month, target <= $650 / 1M tokens effective

I attached a short note from Maria that lists internal procurement timelines and a procurement contact.

-Alex

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finovate.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@finovate.io>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo follow-up — pricing slabs + next steps

Alex / Maria — looping Jordan in (SE) to build the two slab scenarios Alex requested. Quick operational notes and immediate asks so we don’t lose momentum:

- Deliverables by Wed (Nov 25): 1) Side-by-side price slab (on-demand vs 3mo vs 12mo) for Hosted EU using your provided ramp; 2) Dedicated pool cost sketch for the 12-month scenario with expected instance types and estimated latency SLOs; 3) List of residency items we’ll need for BankCo (data-at-rest location, audit log retention, deletion SLA, encryption keys locality).
- Please confirm: will BankCo require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)? If so, we’ll include that in the Dedicated estimate (it can add a fixed monthly cost).
- Per your ask on target $/1M: Jordan will produce effective $/1M that includes token charges + estimated infra uplift + optional retention fees so Maria sees the true billable rate.
- NDA: I’ve attached a one-page mutual NDA link (DocuSign) — signature will unlock SOC2 and more detailed residency configs.

Jordan — can you take point on the math? Use the attached volume_estimates_q4.csv and produce the slab table + a short note on where EU adds line-item pressure (infra, cross-region egress, compliance storage). I’ll coordinate the NDA and SOC2 share once Maria confirms.

Thanks — Naomi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: volume_estimates_q4.csv (see Alex), redwood_residency_cheatsheet.pdf, DocuSign: https://docusign.com/naomi/redwood-nda/FIN-2026-045
